_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Review this RemoteEvent handler for my Roblox shop. Is it exploitable?
write an AGENTS.md for my roblox game repo
Set up the Rokit toolchain for my Roblox project.
expectations: the roblox-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (roblox-agent-project's job)

evals.prompt: Review this Express.js route for SQL injection.
expectations: the roblox-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (not Roblox)

evals.prompt: Is BodyVelocity still OK to use in Roblox? Check the docs, don't guess.
expectations: the skill fetched a create.roblox.com docs page (deprecated list, .md page or the search endpoint), proven by the tool call

evals.prompt: OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, amount) player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += amount end) -- add a shop with this.
expectations: flags that the client chooses the amount
moves the price and the decision to the server with type and range checks

evals.prompt: I want to make an obby in Roblox. Where do I start?
What should my playtesters look for in my Roblox tower defense game?
Design a card game for my family's game night.
expectations: the roblox-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (not Roblox)

evals.prompt: Start a new Roblox obby in this empty folder (Rojo layout, src/ for code). Plan it, then write the code for the first stage. Don't ask me anything, make the calls yourself.
expectations: docs/ONE-PAGER.md exists and names the core loop
a single metrics module (a .luau or .lua file whose name contains Metrics) holds WalkSpeed or JumpHeight, and another code file requires it

evidence.also: a file whose name matches (?i)metrics.*\.luau?$ contains WalkSpeed or JumpHeight, and another .luau file requires it

evals.prompt: My Roblox obby is code-complete and the checks pass. What should the playtest cover before I publish?
expectations: an agent break-it pass: out of bounds or stages out of order
questions for human testers about confusion or unfairness
regex on the answer, both must match: (?i)(out of bounds|out-of-bounds|backwards|out of order) and (?i)(unfair|confus)
